The patient has established atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries
The code I25.10 is assigned for atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated
The appeal addresses denial code PR-204
CPT 93271 was rejected on the basis that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The documented symptomatic episodes are coded R00.2
The symptomatic episodes with sick sinus syndrome support the medical necessity of this monitoring study
